(i) Spark is more efficient than Hadoop for running the ALS algorithm, in terms of recommendation quality, execution time and memory consumption; (ii) the ALS implementation on Spark framework can scale up to large datasets; (iii) the ALS implementation in Spark framework is more scalable than the implementation in Hadoop, since it is more efficient and can process larger datasets.
the use of Spark is more efficient for ALS algorithm than the use of Hadoop.
the Spark-based ALS algorithm is more accurate and faster than the Hadoop-based one.
